reading.body:
CyrusOne Wappingers Falls, NY (NYM7) in Wappingers Falls, New York, publishes 3 MW of IT capacity across 100,000 square feet of technical space, operated by CyrusOne.

At 10 kW per rack, a common enterprise colocation density, that load supports roughly 300 racks. At 40 kW per rack, a density closer to AI training workloads, it supports roughly 75 racks. The operator has not published a per-rack power envelope, so neither figure is the operator's own claim, only what the published megawattage implies under each assumption.

CyrusOne Wappingers Falls, NY (NYM7) holds 1 published certification: SSAE 16 Type II (a specific compliance or security standard). Together these qualify the facility for regulated workloads spanning security auditing, payments, and healthcare data, though which specific tenants rely on which certification is not disclosed.

New York has 1 facility mapped in this site's dataset, of which 1 publish a megawatt figure, totaling 3 MW. CyrusOne Wappingers Falls, NY (NYM7) contributes 3 MW of that total. At that published size it is a small facility relative to what frontier AI training infrastructure requires, which now runs into the tens or hundreds of megawatts, though it may still support inference workloads or smaller-scale AI applications.
